:::{#exr-slr-additive}
#### Decomposing an outcome

Express each outcome $\Outvar_\iobs$ in a conditional Gaussian model (@def-cond-gaussian)
in terms of its conditional mean $\mean_i$ and its deviation $\cdev_i$ (@def-slr-deviation).
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-slr-additive}

Check that $\Outvar_\iobs = \mean_i + \cdev_i$, starting from the right-hand side:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\mean_i + \cdev_i
&= \mean(x_i) + \cdev_i
&& \text{(definition of $\mean_i$)}\\
&= \mean(x_i) + \paren{\Outvar_\iobs - \mean(x_i)}
&& \text{(definition of $\cdev_i$)}\\
&= \mean(x_i) + \Outvar_\iobs - \mean(x_i)
&& \text{(remove the parentheses)}\\
&= \Outvar_\iobs + \mean(x_i) - \mean(x_i)
&& \text{(reorder the terms)}\\
&= \Outvar_\iobs + \paren{\mean(x_i) - \mean(x_i)}
&& \text{(group the last two terms)}\\
&= \Outvar_\iobs + 0
&& \text{($a - a = 0$)}\\
&= \Outvar_\iobs
&& \text{($a + 0 = a$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

So $\Outvar_\iobs = \mean_i + \cdev_i$.

{{< slidebreak >}}

Alternatively, solve the definition of $\cdev_i$ for $\Outvar_\iobs$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\cdev_i
&= \Outvar_\iobs - \mean(x_i)
&& \text{(definition of $\cdev_i$)}\\
\cdev_i + \mean(x_i)
&= \Outvar_\iobs - \mean(x_i) + \mean(x_i)
&& \text{(add $\mean(x_i)$ to both sides)}\\
\cdev_i + \mean(x_i)
&= \Outvar_\iobs + \paren{-\mean(x_i)} + \mean(x_i)
&& \text{(subtracting is adding the negative)}\\
\cdev_i + \mean(x_i)
&= \Outvar_\iobs + \paren{-\mean(x_i) + \mean(x_i)}
&& \text{(group the last two terms)}\\
\cdev_i + \mean(x_i)
&= \Outvar_\iobs + 0
&& \text{($-a + a = 0$)}\\
\cdev_i + \mean(x_i)
&= \Outvar_\iobs
&& \text{($a + 0 = a$)}\\
\Outvar_\iobs
&= \cdev_i + \mean(x_i)
&& \text{(swap the two sides)}\\
\Outvar_\iobs
&= \mean(x_i) + \cdev_i
&& \text{(reorder the terms)}\\
\Outvar_\iobs
&= \mean_i + \cdev_i
&& \text{(definition of $\mean_i$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
